changes: Renamed Pad Pressure Fix: it now fixes pad pressure during retrig rolls too.
Hold a pad in a roll (RTRG held or ALWAYS ON) and its aftertouch targets and MIDI poly pressure follow your pressure, as on a plain held pad.
With VEL.CUR OFF, pressure still sets the roll's velocity as before; set VEL.CUR for aftertouch alone.
With RTRG held and VEL.CUR set, stock sent pressure nowhere; it now reaches aftertouch.
CHROMATIC pads still send their aftertouch on the note they played.
First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: CHROMATIC pads send their aftertouch on the note they played.
Stock sent the poly pressure 24 semitones above the note on, so a synth following the held note saw no aftertouch.
The pressure stays on the held note when UP or DOWN shift the pads, and stops at the note off.
Nothing else changes, and there is nothing to set.
